response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but he falls short on critical requirements for this executive-level role: his German is self-rated as basic (the role requires minimum C1), he has no formal team leadership or technical project management track record, and there is no evidence of UML, Python proficiency, or client-facing architecture consulting. His profile fits a senior IC role far better than a Head of Development position.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software development experience across web, backend, embedded, and high-scale systems
Genuine open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, D-language libraries, FOSS4G speaker) aligned with digital sovereignty focus
Strong Linux/DevOps background and demonstrated mentoring via workshops, courses, and community teaching
concerns: German language at basic level, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal experience leading teams, managing client projects, or operating at executive level
Missing key desired skills: no Python, no UML/modeling expertise, limited requirements-management and consulting exposure

key_factors.factor: German proficiency gap (basic vs. C1 required)
Lack of leadership and project management experience
Strong open-source, Linux, and broad engineering expertise
